Name: Winter Bathroom Custom Furniture
Author: Robokit12
Description:
OUTDATED MOD! Please note! I don´t plan on modding anymore. But if someone feels like it don't hesitate to change/update and reupload any of my files. I wouldn´t mind it.

Another bathroom furniture fitting the Vanilla game graphics. 
 
[b]Includes:[/b]

Bathtub (animated)
Sink
Toilet (useable as chair)
Dresser (decor only)
Rug

All items can be bought at Robins Carpenter Shop.

A DGA version converted by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/124850573]NOAV7[/url] can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16537]here[/url].

 
[b]Installation: [/b]Just download the file and extract it to your mod folder.

Please note that items may conflict with other installed custom furniture if those were created with Platonymous Custom Furniture Mod! If this happens just open the WinterBathroom.json file and change the "id" number to something else that isn´t used yet (e.g. 6 to 26).
[b] 
Created with:[/b]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture Mod by Platonymous

Hope you enjoy :)!
